turns.user: my dumbbells only go up to 24kg each and bench is getting easy, should I just go to 40kg
turns.reply:
Not 40kg — that's a massive jump, and going from 24kg to 40kg per hand is how shoulders get hurt. 🏋️

Since your kit tops out at 24kg, try slowing down your tempo by taking 3–4 seconds to lower the weight to make it feel heavier. There are other options too, but are you aiming to build size, or purely chasing heavier numbers?
